QueryText: SELECT * FROM "task_tracker"."tasks" WHERE epic_id IS NULL LIMIT 300 OFFSET 0

select
    time_tracks.id,
    time_tracks.comment,
    assignees.spec,
    tasks.type,
    tasks.name AS task_name,
    tasks.priority,
    epics.name AS epic_name,
    epics.project_id
FROM task_tracker.time_tracks
    LEFT OUTER JOIN task_tracker.assignees ON assignees.id = time_tracks.assignee_id
    LEFT OUTER JOIN task_tracker.tasks ON tasks.id = assignees.task_id
    LEFT OUTER JOIN task_tracker.epics ON epics.id = tasks.epic_id
    LEFT OUTER JOIN task_tracker.projects ON projects.id = epics.project_id
WHERE epics.project_id IS NULL
